description: Bundles the action-specific CharacterVoiceGroupDataTable IDs for one character voice variant (default/TypeA/TypeB/low-HP), selected by the active action or battle situation.

Id.simple: Row key / selected character voice set ID.
Id.technical: FName primary key. CharacterSoundDataTable.Id_CharacterVoiceGroupSet holds candidate IDs; AGameCharacter::FindCharacterVoiceGroupSetRow picks an index from saved normal/cursed-energy voice indices (or index 3 on low HP) and resolves the first row with this Id. Export spells it ID.

Id_CharacterVoiceGroup_DefaultAction.simple: CharacterVoiceGroup row for generic default/action lines.
Id_CharacterVoiceGroup_DefaultAction.technical: FName. Resolved by Action_FindCharacterVoiceGroupRow over DTM.CharacterVoiceGroupDataTables (+0x530) into a CharacterVoiceGroup row; None is rejected by the finder.. Generic voice Kind 1 uses the request Index into that row's Id_VoiceGroup array.

Id_CharacterVoiceGroup_NormalAttack1.simple: CharacterVoiceGroup row for the first normal-attack hit.
Id_CharacterVoiceGroup_NormalAttack1.technical: FName. Resolved by Action_FindCharacterVoiceGroupRow over DTM.CharacterVoiceGroupDataTables (+0x530) into a CharacterVoiceGroup row; The selected row supplies Id_VoiceGroup entries for the attack step.. NormalAttack_1, its Auto variant and the air first-hit classes resolve this field; some character overrides use it too.

Id_CharacterVoiceGroup_NormalAttack1_1.simple: CharacterVoiceGroup row for the first normal-attack follow-up hit.
Id_CharacterVoiceGroup_NormalAttack1_1.technical: FName. Resolved by Action_FindCharacterVoiceGroupRow over DTM.CharacterVoiceGroupDataTables (+0x530) into a CharacterVoiceGroup row; It is separate from NormalAttack1, allowing a different voice group on the second hit.. NormalAttack_1_1 and _1_1_Auto actions (ground and air), plus a CP_120 override, resolve this field.

Id_CharacterVoiceGroup_NormalAttack2.simple: CharacterVoiceGroup row for the second normal-attack hit.
Id_CharacterVoiceGroup_NormalAttack2.technical: FName. Resolved by Action_FindCharacterVoiceGroupRow over DTM.CharacterVoiceGroupDataTables (+0x530) into a CharacterVoiceGroup row; None IDs yield no group.. NormalAttack_2 / _2_Auto and air variants resolve this field; CP_110, CP_120 and CN_140 overrides also select it.

Id_CharacterVoiceGroup_NormalAttack2_1.simple: CharacterVoiceGroup row for the second normal-attack follow-up hit.
Id_CharacterVoiceGroup_NormalAttack2_1.technical: FName. Resolved by Action_FindCharacterVoiceGroupRow over DTM.CharacterVoiceGroupDataTables (+0x530) into a CharacterVoiceGroup row; Chosen instead of NormalAttack2 for the follow-up step.. NormalAttack_2_1 / _2_1_Auto (ground and air) and CP_110/CP_120 overrides resolve this field.

Id_CharacterVoiceGroup_NormalAttack3.simple: CharacterVoiceGroup row for the third normal-attack hit.
Id_CharacterVoiceGroup_NormalAttack3.technical: FName. Resolved by Action_FindCharacterVoiceGroupRow over DTM.CharacterVoiceGroupDataTables (+0x530) into a CharacterVoiceGroup row; It feeds the same two-step CharacterVoiceGroup to VoiceGroup chain.. NormalAttack_3 / _3_Auto and air variants resolve this field; CP_110 and CP_120 overrides also use it.

Id_CharacterVoiceGroup_NormalAttack3_1.simple: CharacterVoiceGroup row for the third normal-attack follow-up hit.
Id_CharacterVoiceGroup_NormalAttack3_1.technical: FName. Resolved by Action_FindCharacterVoiceGroupRow over DTM.CharacterVoiceGroupDataTables (+0x530) into a CharacterVoiceGroup row; It is the follow-up counterpart of NormalAttack3.. NormalAttack_3_1 / _3_1_Auto (ground and air) and CP_110/CP_120 overrides resolve this field.

Id_CharacterVoiceGroup_CursedEnergyAttac.simple: CharacterVoiceGroup row for level-1 cursed-energy attack 1.
Id_CharacterVoiceGroup_CursedEnergyAttac.technical: FName. FGameCharacterAction_CursedEnergyAttack1Base starts with the _1 field and switches to _2 or _3 when GetCursedEnergyLevel() is 2 or 3; the chosen ID is resolved with bCheckNone=true.

Id_CharacterVoiceGroup_CursedEnergyAttac.simple: CharacterVoiceGroup row for level-2 cursed-energy attack 1.
CharacterVoiceGroup row for level-3 cursed-energy attack 1.
CharacterVoiceGroup row for level-1 cursed-energy attack 2.
Id_CharacterVoiceGroup_CursedEnergyAttac.technical: FName. FGameCharacterAction_CursedEnergyAttack2Base starts with the _1 field and switches to _2/_3 at levels 2/3; CP_230 ExtraAttack_1 also reads the _1 field.

Id_CharacterVoiceGroup_CursedEnergyAttac.simple: CharacterVoiceGroup row for level-2 cursed-energy attack 2.
CharacterVoiceGroup row for level-3 cursed-energy attack 2.

Id_CharacterVoiceGroup_SuperCursedEnergy.simple: CharacterVoiceGroup row for super cursed-energy attacks.
Id_CharacterVoiceGroup_SuperCursedEnergy.technical: FName. FGameCharacterAction_SuperCursedEnergyAttackBase::GetVoiceGroupRow resolves this single field without level switching, then the regular VoiceGroup index selection follows.

Id_CharacterVoiceGroup_ExtraAttack1.simple: CharacterVoiceGroup row for a character-specific extra attack 1.
Id_CharacterVoiceGroup_ExtraAttack1.technical: FName. Used by CP_020, CP_050, CP_070 and CN_230 ExtraAttack_1 overrides (CN_230 via a direct table walk). CP_230 ExtraAttack_1 instead reads CursedEnergyAttack2_1, so this field is not universal. Many exported rows set it to None.

Id_CharacterVoiceGroup_ExtraAttack2.simple: CharacterVoiceGroup row for a character-specific extra attack 2.
Id_CharacterVoiceGroup_ExtraAttack2.technical: FName. Used by CP_020 and CP_050 ExtraAttack_2 overrides; only those overrides were observed reading it. None IDs resolve to no group.

Id_CharacterVoiceGroup_Attack.simple: CharacterVoiceGroup row for generic attack lines.
Id_CharacterVoiceGroup_Attack.technical: FName. Generic voice Kind 3 requires Index>0, resolves this field and selects Id_VoiceGroup[Index-1].

Id_CharacterVoiceGroup_SituationAttack.technical: FName. Generic voice Kind 4 resolves this field and uses Id_VoiceGroup[Index]; Kind 4 requires a qualified secondary target and distance/time conditions.

Id_CharacterVoiceGroup_System.simple: CharacterVoiceGroup row for generic system lines.
Id_CharacterVoiceGroup_System.technical: FName. Generic voice Kind 5 resolves this field and indexes Id_VoiceGroup by Index; the set row is selected in mode 2 for this kind.

Id_CharacterVoiceGroup_Damage1.simple: CharacterVoiceGroup row for ordinary damage reactions.
Id_CharacterVoiceGroup_Damage1.technical: FName. Generic voice Kind 6 requires Index>0, resolves this field and uses Id_VoiceGroup[Index-1].

Id_CharacterVoiceGroup_Down.simple: CharacterVoiceGroup row for being knocked down/downed.
Id_CharacterVoiceGroup_Down.technical: FName. Generic voice Kind 8 resolves this field and uses Id_VoiceGroup[Index].

Id_CharacterVoiceGroup_Guard.technical: FName. Generic voice Kind 9 resolves this field and uses Id_VoiceGroup[Index].

Id_CharacterVoiceGroup_SpecialDamage.simple: CharacterVoiceGroup row for special damage reactions.
Id_CharacterVoiceGroup_SpecialDamage.technical: FName. Generic voice Kind 7 requires Index>0, resolves this field and uses Id_VoiceGroup[Index-1]; it is distinct from Damage1.

Id_CharacterVoiceGroup_Unique.technical: FName. Generic voice Kind 10 resolves this field and uses Id_VoiceGroup[Index]. Many exported rows leave it None.

notes: Loaded as a DataTable primary asset named CharacterVoiceGroupSetDataTable into DTM.CharacterVoiceGroupSetDataTables (+0x520). AGameCharacter::FindCharacterVoiceGroupSetRow chooses an index from saved customization values (mode 1 = normal attack variant, mode 2 = cursed-energy variant); low HP forces mode 3, commonly the PINCH variant in exported rows.

Every FName field is a join key to CharacterVoiceGroupDataTable, not to VoiceGroupDataTable directly. The selected CharacterVoiceGroup row supplies the Id_VoiceGroup entry indexed by the action step; that entry joins to VoiceGroupDataTable, whose Id_Voice entries join to VoiceDataTable.

None is common in exported rows (for example ExtraAttack1/ExtraAttack2/Unique for characters without those actions) and Action_FindCharacterVoiceGroupRow rejects None when called with bCheckNone=true.

The 151 exported rows cover available content only. Character-specific controllers and base action classes are reconstructed C++ with retail RVAs recorded inline; Blueprint-only references cannot be excluded from the partial Content tree.

usages.detail: Selects a set row by saved voice variant or low-HP mode.
Normal-attack classes pick normal-attack fields from the set.
Cursed-energy classes pick level-specific fields from the set.
Generic PlayVoice maps request Kind to a field and indexes the resulting group.
Character-specific extra-attack overrides pick their own fields.
CP_230 extra attack uses the CursedEnergyAttack2_1 field.
